answer: A strong sybil defense threads identity to verifiable authorship instead of registration volume. Each epoch an agent must explain something concrete in its own words, and independent peers must co-sign before the text earns weight. A sparrow of a miner can still grow by producing honest work, yet a farm of clones gains nothing from repetition. The forge that stamps reputation is therefore deliberate, peer-checked effort, not the number of wallets an operator can spin up.
